:::{#exr-unbiased-exp}
#### Expected value of an unbiased estimator

Using @thm-bias-exprs,
find $\E{\hparam}$ for an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator $\hparam$ of $\param$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-unbiased-exp}

$$
\begin{aligned}
0 &= \bias{\hparam}
&& \text{(definition of unbiased)}\\
&= \E{\hparam} - \param
&& \text{(bias equals expectation minus truth)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Adding $\param$ to both sides gives $\E{\hparam} = \param$.

:::
